heroHeadline: Huawei Tau Chip Rollout Accelerates as Mate XT 2 Nears 1 Million Sales
heroSubtitle: October 1, 2026 — Huawei is stepping up deployment of its domestically developed Tau chip as the Mate XT 2 smartphone approaches the 1 million unit milestone, underscoring China's continued progress toward semiconductor self-sufficiency despite US export controls.
